problem_title: The openness and smooth-witness conjecture for repeated integrals

evidence.text:
We prove Burke–Haris–Madhavendra Conjecture 1.2 for every order, including order zero. An atomless Stieltjes measure has a strictly positive smooth density realizing its finitely many moments and equal to one near the endpoints. Separation, an explicit bump-moment openness argument and repeated integration give the full source endpoint-jet statement.
